ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent workflow that coordinates local microgrid energy distribution using decentralized LLM routing for rural Indian communities.
ideas.title: AuraNet Agent

ideas.pitch: An offline-capable AI crop disease and yield prediction agent running locally to assist smallholder farmers without relying on continuous cloud connectivity.
ideas.title: AgriGuard Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the SDG and Social Impact track (Zero Hunger) while leaning into local agricultural contexts familiar to judges in Sonipat.

ideas.title: CivicPulse Agent
